manual_assessments.area: Captured input closure and execution refusal
manual_assessments.evidence: Digest/file-identity checks precede execution of captured helper/utility bytes; private non-main namespaces never call old observe/CLI. Exact ten request fields bind hashes, fresh nonce, original bootstrap and host/self. --execute rejection precedes parser/request/utilities. No old production/native guard modification.

Owned disjoint new root and sibling marker are absent then consumed before compile. Production supplies validate_inputs before compile and immediately before runtime: original input bytes/identities, observer self and marker. Compiler/product artifacts are rechecked before runtime. Parent/root identities and final entry/bootstrap/host checks are postvalidation; documentation states this timing accurately.

Dedicated C uses header SYS_pidfd_open with explicit long number/PID and unsigned-long zero flags, nonnegative/LONG_MAX bounds, sizeof(pid_t)<=sizeof(long), representable int FD handoff, no arbitrary PID/flag arguments. CPP markers occur once; runtime prints macro/sizeof facts separately. Python never evaluates opaque header expressions or historic434.

Bounded /proc/self/stat PID establishes supported procfs namespace; exactly one positive decimal fdinfo Pid must match current getpid. poll initializes one POLLIN FD with timeout0 and requires rc0/revents0. Every normal representable acquired-FD path has at most one close attempt; immediate close errno retained, no EINTR retry, successful close followed directly by F_GETFD=-1/EBADF without a descriptor-opening operation. First failure and later close facts remain distinct.

Descriptor inode/fstat/acquired flags explicitly unobserved; ownership observation is current-PID fdinfo+controlled source flow. C terminal-output failure, async interruption and host loss can leave incomplete evidence. Stdio proc streams are outside pidfd close_calls. Success is narrow current-program behavior, not kernel-global/model ABI, complete containment, resource lease or restoration.

manual_assessments.area: GNU link inventory and product interpreter
manual_assessments.evidence: LOAD parser preserves safe absolute lexical ../ aliases while refusing normalized/resolved virtual roots and malformed rows; every inventory leaf is bounded existing regular data, missing files fail. Raw map and original spelling retained. ELF ET_EXEC/ET_DYN class/order/PHT bounds and exactly one bounded terminated PT_INTERP are checked, with actual canonical interpreter hash/rechecks. Descriptive post-link LOAD/interpreter identities do not authenticate bytes during link, complete toolchains or mapped library payloads.

Exact typed/duplicate-key/nonfinite JSON checks bind C PID to fresh Popen PID, PPID to observer and UID/eUID to declared user. Compiled width/order facts must agree. Success recomputes acquired/current PID, poll event+result, one successful close and actual fcntl rc/errno chain, plus a non-timed-out reaped zero child. Returned booleans alone cannot unlock success.

Object/header/compiler, link/map/product/interpreter and compiler/runtime stdout/stderr bindings are rechecked around runtime. C negatives preserve handled returned facts; exceptions/partial output leave flags false. Top-level promotion additionally follows input/self/marker/root postvalidation. Nested immutable compile_leg false runtime/own-FD fields and zero product execution are explicitly scoped separately from new aggregate link/runtime.

Captured backend regular streams and fresh direct Popen handles preserve bounded30s wait/one direct kill/2s reap/error metadata. Dedicated C itself has no signal/child calls; whole phase does create compiler/product children and may signal a timed-out direct child. Descendant/host-loss cleanup and physical exclusion remain unverified; all containment/execution/resource/model authority fields remain false.

Synthetic backend tests cover malformed/foreign/false success, actual poll/close/EBADF fact checks, failed C fact retention, strict types, LOAD aliases/virtual paths, ELF/interpreter bounds, link/product/interpreter/source drift, early execute refusal, consumption and precompile/preruntime callbacks. Mocks are explicit CPU fixtures, not real ABI/GPU/queue evidence.
